$comment: allowImportingTsExtensions is not a convenience here, it is a requirement. scripts/** is EXECUTED by `node --experimental-strip-types` (see the node() helper in scripts/verify.ts), and node does no .js->.ts remapping, so a sibling import inside scripts/ must be spelled `./yaml.ts`. Without this flag tsc rejects exactly those specifiers (TS5097) while node requires them — the two halves of the toolchain disagreeing, which is what produced 8 of this package's 15 errors. The flag needs noEmit, which is set below. src/** is the opposite case and uses `.js`; see tsconfig.src.json and the runtime-import-extension lint rule.
